booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/todd-lake-recreation-area ('This campground operates on a first-come, first-served basis.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Not suitable for large RVs (USFS). One RV or two tents, two vehicles and eight people at most per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/todd-lake-recreation-area ('Not suitable for large RVs.', 'Campsites are limited to one RV or two tents, no more than two vehicles, and no more than eight persons per site.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Showers for Todd Lake campers only. Wheelchair-accessible beach, playground.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/todd-lake-recreation-area ('Dump station is available. Showers available for Todd Lake campers only.', 'Flush toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: $20 per campsite per night; day use $8 per vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/todd-lake-recreation-area ('Single Site: $20 per night', 'Day use is $8 per vehicle up to eight passengers'; page dated May 15, 2026), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Senior and Access passes halve the base campsite fee; no other America the Beautiful passes are valid here.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/todd-lake-recreation-area ('The America the Beautiful Senior and Access Pass provides a 50% discount to the base campsite fee (not hook ups) and the day use fee.'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed FCFS, $20/night and Senior/Access discount; added season mid-May to late October, flush toilets/water/showers/dump, the 'not suitable for large RVs' warning. Not stated: site count (18 left derived), rig length, hookups.
